metadata.description: Adolescent self-report indicator of material family affluence for school and population surveys.
metadata.intended_use: International school-health surveys and socioeconomic-stratification research with adolescents.
metadata.name_origin: Family Affluence Scale, third revision, abbreviated FAS III.
metadata.development_history: Revised to improve cross-national measurement of material family affluence among adolescents.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Concrete household possessions and conditions can provide a less abstract socioeconomic indicator for adolescents.
metadata.interpretation_notes: FAS is not a complete measure of socioeconomic status; interpret across time and country carefully and do not substitute it for income or deprivation data.

versions.source_citation: Hartley et al. (2016). Assessing family socioeconomic position through adolescent self-report: the Family Affluence Scale III.

source_documents.title: Family Affluence Scale III source publication
